title: CMA veterinary price-transparency compliance for independent practices

problem_severity_frequency.rationale: Mandatory, dated transparency duties for every practice, reinforced by a funded regulator platform.

buyer_budget_clarity.rationale: Buyer is the independent practice owner/manager (~2,382 practices); practices already pay for PMS but the compliance budget is unproven.

evidence_strength.rationale: Primary government/regulator documents plus dated provider pages establish the mandate and competitive supply.

distribution.rationale: Plausible trade-body route (RCVS/BVA/FIVP) but no prospects or demonstrated reach.

differentiation.rationale: Capped at 2: direct incumbents contest the wedge; >=4 providers, two free forever.

validation_speed_cost.rationale: Landing-page plus free-tool test is cheap and fast.

feasibility.rationale: Simple hosted price list, templates and record-keeping; no novel technology.

economics.rationale: Capped at 2: economics untested/modelled; free entrants anchor the price at zero.

founder_fit.rationale: Buildable by a small team, but distribution into a crowded compliance niche is the weak point.

risk.rationale: No regulated activity; main risk is dependency on CMA/RCVS timetables and commodity price pressure.

painful_frequent_or_budgeted.note: Mandatory duties with staged 2026-2027 deadlines and a funded regulator levy.

non_paid_distribution.note: Trade-body route unproven for a new entrant.
non_paid_distribution.resolve_via: Ask FIVP/BVA whether a vendor can reach members without paid placement; test organic acquisition via a free price-list tool.

defensible_wedge.note: Wedge is a standard feature of PMS/website vendors; >=4 providers, two free forever.

plausible_margins.note: Free-forever anchor; conversion and CAC/LTV unproven.
plausible_margins.resolve_via: Convert a free-tool cohort to GBP49/month and measure CAC/LTV against VetGuard's anchor.

acceptable_risk.note: No regulated activity; dependencies on CMA/RCVS timetables only.

cheap_disconfirming_test.note: Landing page plus free price-list tool falsifies demand cheaply.

not_all_optimistic.note: Case depends on conversion against free incumbents.
not_all_optimistic.resolve_via: Run the pilot; if free tools hold price at zero, the case fails.
